data.description:
For those who havent heard yet Blink 182 is officially reunited and will be touring SUMMER 09!!!... and just to give sometime to get the word out we'll celebrate this by listening to all things blink on wednesday, february 11th

if your at onu, stop by founders 115 where blink will be playing all day long!!!

also, if youre not a big fan of blink, i first have to ask why you would join this event, and secondly ask that you refrain from writing about how you think they suck and you hate them on the wall. in all honesty you need to find something better to do with your time...

Hey everyone,
So as it turns out in just under 96 hours we found a group of over 14,000 people who love blink and cant wait for their return!! how awesome!! dont let the celebration end here, please join this group http://www.facebook.com/group.php?gid=62459569488&ref=ts 
its the official welcome back blink group with over 10,000 members in the first 4 days and it would be greatly appreciated 

INTERNATIONAL BLINK 182 DAY: http://www.facebook.com/event.php?eid=125270440275&ref=ts
data.location: Everywhere
data.name: "Welcome Back Blink-182" Day
